# Minimal public-domain workflow fixture

This fixture supplies two short clauses from the United States Constitution, a work of the
United States government in the public domain. It is intentionally tiny: maintainers use it to
exercise artifact creation, quote verification, human-code ingestion, deterministic analysis,
and replication without spending money or downloading a research corpus.

The fixture is not evidence for a publishable claim. Live literature review, current model and
price checks, data authorization, researcher approvals, and preregistration cannot be replaced by
recorded test data. Tests must label any such substitution as fixture-only.

Source: National Archives, *The Constitution of the United States: A Transcription*,
<https://www.archives.gov/founding-docs/constitution-transcript>.
